text:
ellis: PM asks for a clearer units control on metric charts (% vs value). current placement is hidden. ideas?
jamie: Inline next to Y label as a compact segmented control. makes it discoverable on dense dashboards.
sara: Agree. Keep labels short: '%' and 'value'. add tooltip: 'Show values relative to selected baseline (percent)'.
a11y-bot: Use role="tablist"/role="tab" for segments, aria-selected, and update a live region when units change.
ellis: Smoothing is next: people can't find it in small multiples. Options: toolbar toggle (global) + legend icon (per-series).
jamie: Toolbar: Off/On. Per-series icon opens intensity slider in series menu.
sara: That balances discoverability and granularity. ensure icon-only button has aria-label like 'Toggle smoothing for <series>'.
a11y-bot: Icon buttons must be keyboard focusable with visible focus ring; check contrast in dark theme.
ellis: Outlier handling: ops wants capping; design wants raw data drillable. proposal: visually clamp at 95th percentile and show a caret where clipped. clicking caret reveals raw points in a panel.
jamie: Add microcopy under chart: 'Some spikes clipped for readability — click to view raw values.'
a11y-bot: Caret must be tabbable with aria-expanded and descriptive alt text 'Some points clipped — press to reveal raw values'.
sara: QA checklist draft: 1) units segmented control visible and keyboard operable; 2) toolbar smoothing toggle functions; 3) legend smoothing icon toggles per-series; 4) clipping caret appears and opens raw table; 5) legend rows toggle visibility with Space/Enter and expose aria-checked.
ellis: Telemetry: chart.units.toggled, chart.smoothing.toggled, chart.clipping.panel_opened.
jamie: I'll add implementation notes: units param maps to units=percent|value, dashboard override shows a subtle badge 'Using dashboard units' on charts.
sara: Final copy approved. filing ticket and tagging eng/product. thanks! :white_check_mark:
